## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences: the problem and the change. Link an issue if there is one. -->

## Kind of change

- [ ] Published results (`results/<suite>/<model-id>/`, generated by `python3 -m decision_bench publish`). Fill in **Results**.
- [ ] New or changed provider adapter in `decision_bench/`. Fill in **Provider**.
- [ ] New or updated model entry in `config/models.json`
- [ ] Harness code or docs
- [ ] Corpus (a new version; existing versions are never edited)
- [ ] Site
- [ ] Dependencies

## Checks

- [ ] `make check` passes (tests, `validate`, secret scan, site build)
- [ ] No API keys, endpoint URLs, private hostnames or local paths in any file

## Results

<!-- Required when the PR changes a results/<suite>/<model-id>/ folder: CI fails until every field below except
     "Anything unusual" has a value.
     Delete this section for any other PR. -->

- Model id:
- Endpoint type: <!-- hosted API, OpenRouter, self-hosted vLLM on <GPU>, ... Never the URL. -->
- Run dates:
- Client location: <!-- the cloud region the run came from (for example us-east-1), or the country for a laptop -->
- Full runs made: <!-- every full run you made with its correct count, and which one this PR publishes -->
- Key type: <!-- a normal customer key, or one with special access (a dedicated deployment, higher limits). Never the key. -->
- Affiliation: <!-- your relation to the model vendor or the provider, or "none" -->
- Anything unusual: <!-- retries, errors, rate limits, git_dirty: true, a model update during the run -->

## Provider

<!-- Required when the PR adds or changes an adapter. Delete this section for any other PR. -->

- Provider id and API:
- Environment variables it reads: <!-- names only -->
- Shared code changed: <!-- every change outside the new adapter module, and which providers it reaches -->
- Network baseline: <!-- the provider's URL is in runner.FIXED_ENDPOINTS or runner.endpoint_url() -->
- Tests: <!-- what the new tests cover; tests never call a real model -->
